newsitem.title: USA: GPU says 17,344 in NJ remain without power.
newsitem.headline: GPU says 17,344 in NJ remain without power.

text.p: GPU Energy said Sunday that about 17,344 customers remained without power in various New Jersey counties hit by a storm Friday night that downed power lines and damaged other equipment.
About 78,000 customers in all were affected, GPU spokeswoman Sue Hohenadel said. "We expect the majority of our customers to be restored by midnight," Hohenadel said.
Hohenadel could not immediately provide an estimated cost for the repair work.
GPU crews from southern New Jersey and eastern Pennsylvania and crews from New York State Electric and Gas, Philadelphia Electric Co, Northeast Utilities and contractor crews are helping, GPU said.
GPU Energy is a unit of GPU Inc.
